visual.description: Full-width navigation bar with icon left, centered logotype wordmark, and icon pair right — three-zone horizontal split.
Full-viewport-width image with centered text overlay (headline + subtitle + two CTA buttons) positioned in the lower-center third of the image.
Full-width section with a single centered uppercase heading, large vertical whitespace above and below.
Two equal-width image cards side by side, each with overlaid uppercase title and a bordered CTA button centered within the image.
Full-width section with a centered uppercase heading and a single centered text link below it.
Three equal-width image cards in a horizontal row, each with a date and a multi-line title below the image.
Full-width section with a single centered uppercase 'SHOP' heading.
Six products arranged in two rows of three equal-width cards, each with a product image, uppercase title, and price below; 'Sold Out' badges appear as black rectangles over the image corner.
Full-width row with a single centered dark filled button labeled 'VIEW ALL'.
Footer split into left column with stacked navigation text links and right column with newsletter signup heading, description, email input with submit icon, and social media icons below.
Full-width bottom bar with centered payment method icons row and copyright text.
